title: Geographical Perspective on Selected Issues and Problems

topics.title: Environmental Pollution and Water Pollution
topics.ncert_sections: Environmental Pollution; Water Pollution; Namami Gange Programme

concepts.learning_objective: Classify environmental pollution by the medium through which pollutants are transported and diffused.
Identify natural and human sources of water pollution in India and their effects on health.
Explain the objectives of the Namami Gange Programme for cleaning the Ganga.
Identify the main sources and pollutants responsible for air pollution.
Explain the effects of air pollution such as disease, urban smog and acid rain.
Identify the main sources of noise pollution and why traffic noise is the biggest nuisance.
Explain how noise is measured and why noise pollution is location specific.

topics.title: Urban Waste Disposal
topics.ncert_sections: Urban Waste Disposal; Case Study: Daurala

concepts.learning_objective: Describe what solid waste is and the two sources from which it is disposed of.
Explain the health hazards of uncollected urban waste and the idea of treating waste as a resource.
Analyse the Daurala case of industrial groundwater contamination and its restoration on the polluter pays principle.
Explain the push and pull factors behind rural-urban migration in India.
Analyse the economic and social effects of migration on migrants and their families.
Explain how Indian urban centres are socially and economically differentiated.
Describe living conditions and socio-economic problems of slum dwellers.

topics.title: Land Degradation
topics.ncert_sections: Land Degradation; A Case Study: Jhabua

concepts.learning_objective: Define land degradation and identify the processes that cause it.
Classify wastelands according to natural and human-induced processes.
Evaluate community participation in watershed management in Jhabua district.
